rows.title_full: AN ACT GOVERNING THE SYSTEM OF PRESCHOOL EDUCATION BY PRESCRIBING STANDARDS AND REGULATIONS OF PRESCHOOL FACILITIES AND SERVICES
rows.title_short: Governance In Preschool Education Act
rows.abstract: Establishes the standards for the operation of preschools to ensure quality preschool education.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2008-12-09, transmitted to on 2008-12-17 and received by the Senate on 2008-12-17

second_reading.remarks: On Nov. 19, 2008, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure; terminated the period of sponsorship and debate; terminated the period of amendments; and approved the same on Second Reading.

rows.author: F092
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AS A CRIME THE ACT OF DRIVING ANY MOTOR VEHICLE WHILE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES AND/OR PROHIBITED DRUGS AND PROVIDING GRADUATED PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Anti-drunk Driving Act
rows.abstract: Prohibits any person to drive or operate any motor vehicle while under the influence of alcoholic beverages (0.6% or more blood alcohol concentration level) and/or prohibited drug.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-09-23

rows.author: F092
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE OFFENSE OF RECKLESS DRIVING AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR THE COMMISSION THEREOF AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes to hold the owner and/or operator oof offending vehicles directly liable for damages, prejudice and injuries that may be caused by wayward drives under their employ.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-09-23

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT CRIMINALIZING THE FAILURE OF OWNERS AND LESSORS OF RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL BUILDINGS TO COMPLY WITH NATIONAL AND LOCAL FIRE SAFETY LAWS
rows.abstract: Proposes to hold owners and lessors of residential and commercial building primarily liable for fire resulting from their non-compliance with national and local fire-safety laws.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-11-18

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AVIATION NOISE MANAGEMENT AND REDUCTION IN RESIDENTIAL AREAS
rows.title_short: Aviation Noise Limit Act Of 2008
rows.abstract: Seeks to establish a program for the management of noise levels in residential areas near airports.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2008-11-18
